Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1 (7 reviewers: 6 Cursor specialists + 1 Codex generic):
- Accepted (implemented): 1 — comment accuracy fix (git diff --quiet HEAD detects staged and unstaged, not unstaged-only)
- Rejected (nit/latent/OOS): 4 — larch-log files expected (infra), whole-tree git add -u acknowledged, untracked-only bypass acknowledged, manifest absolute paths pre-existing
- Codex: NO_ISSUES_FOUND
